mechanism_narrative: Continued collapse in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates suppressed commuting and discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -64.9 and WORKPLACES at -54.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days while TRANSIT <= -60 and WORKPLACES <= -50 at t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM falls to or below -15.0, essential shopping trips contract, reducing overall retail traffic; therefore RETAIL_REC will decline over the next week.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM <= -15.0 and mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is greater than mean RETAIL_REC over the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: High RESIDENTIAL combined with low WORKPLACES indicates strong stay-at-home compliance; this interaction suppresses retail-and-recreation trips, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If when RESIDENTIAL > 20 and WORKPLACES < -50, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is greater than mean RETAIL_REC over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening lockdown regime, TRANSIT declines lead RETAIL_REC declines by one week; with TRANSIT at -64.9, RETAIL_REC will fall over the next week.
failure_condition: If in weeks where TRANSIT < -60, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not lower than RETAIL_REC over the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Parks mobility has rebounded from -42.1 to -35.7, signaling outdoor activity substitution that lifts adjacent retail-and-recreation footfall; RETAIL_REC will rise over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -42.1 to -35.7 by t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS > -36 and mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than or equal to mean RETAIL_REC over the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: The week-on-week WORKPLACES drop from -39.1 to -54.9 signals accelerating workplace closures; because retail footfall depends on commuting, RETAIL_REC will decline over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -39.1 to -54.9 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES <= -50 and mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is greater than mean RETAIL_REC over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Transit collapse limits access to grocery/pharmacy, and grocery contraction reduces retail footfall; their interaction predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT < -60 and GROCERY_PHARM < -10, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Delhi pre-monsoon heat onset suppresses outdoor retail-and-recreation activity; PARKS will decline further and drag RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS rises or stays flat over the next 28 days and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.
